leadText:
A Hex Maniac (Japanese: オカルトマニア Occult Maniac) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation III games. They appear as girls dressed as witches in Generation III and as girls in long black dresses in Generation VI. They appear to be possessed in the Japanese versions of the Generation III games, much like s before them. Though regardless of this, they often have a spooky, eerie demeanor to them.

In Double Battles, a Hex Maniac paired up with a battle together as .

They specialize in a combination of - and .

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Hex Maniac Helena forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Helena became a playable sync pair on October 17, 2022.

 
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
===== =====
In Verily Vanquishing Vileplume I, a Hex Maniac named Valerie (Honoka in the Chuang Yi translation) is seen battling Dusty in the Battle Dome. While it is unknown who won, what is known is Valerie at some point lost a match, eliminating her from the tournament.

===== =====
A Hex Maniac was one of the people swarming the Mossdeep Space Center in Diancie Shines.

===== =====
In Sylveon Enchants, a Hex Maniac is seen at the Mini-game Corner with her .

==Trivia==
On the second floor of the Lumiose City's Fighting Dojo building, a Hex Maniac will appear, say "No, you're not the one...", and float away. The meaning of this in-game event, if it has any, is so far unknown. 
In , on the first floor of Mt. Pyre's inner section, a Hex Maniac says: "... No, you're not the one. ... Ah..."
This incident is referenced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A; one of the Hex Maniacs in the Z-A Royale says that she wishes to win in order to find out what that "No, you're not the one" meant. Zach also mentions a story about a girl who hitches a taxi without the driver letting her on, and the girl states, "You're not the one, either..." in Side Mission 192: The Stealthy Shadow, Gardie also mentions the event as a story posted on the Hex Maniac Channel.
A Hex Maniac can be seen in the background of the Haunted House stage of Pokkén Tournament, frantically trying to open a locked door.
In Pokémon GO, "Hex Maniac" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 10 Pokémon.
